title: Candy Prices Going Up!
story: The cost of candy is rising because it's getting more expensive to make sweets. When prices go up, families might buy less candy.
storyBig: Inflation has increased, leading to higher production costs for candies. This might result in decreased consumer demand as prices rise.
think: What happens when things we like get more expensive?
bull: High prices can mean candy is more special when you get it!
bear: You might not get as much candy if it costs more.

title: Toy Brick and Kite Makers Team Up
story: The toy brick and kite companies might join together! They think it will help them make better toys for everyone.
storyBig: The companies producing toy bricks and kites are considering a merger to leverage their combined strengths for enhanced product offerings.
think: Why would two companies want to become one?
bull: New toy ideas can be really exciting!
bear: Not everyone might like the new changes.
